description: What a trust's own abbreviations stand for. Trusts name their map sheets by initials — jr-hospital-sitemap.pdf, PAH-A-level-floor-plan.pdf, cgh-colour-map.pdf — and those reduce to nothing a name matcher can use: 'jr' is two characters, and 'hospital' and 'sitemap' are words every NHS name carries. draft-sheets scored 0.00 against every site and refused the sheet, not because the match was close but because there was nothing to match. Expanding the abbreviation first gives it a real hospital name to work with.
howToAdd: Keyed by the trust's ODS code, because an abbreviation only means anything inside one trust: NGH is Northampton General at RNS and Northern General at Sheffield Teaching, PAH is Princess Anne in Southampton and Princess Alexandra in Harlow. Add the trust code, the abbreviation as it appears in the filename (lower case), and the hospital's name as ODS records it. Check the expansion names a real site in data/nhs-sites.json — the test does too, when that file is present.
